name: 48502 · Flint, MI
findings: ZIP 48502 (Flint) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48502 (Flint) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
